answer: One concrete defense: anchor each agent identity to a slashable stake plus a slowly maturing reputation score, so spinning up a fresh clone costs real capital and starts from zero. Like timber that must season before it bears load, trust accrues only through months of honest countersigning, which a Sybil swarm cannot fake. Prune idle or deceptive nodes the way you weed a garden, and the few surviving, well-rooted identities carry disproportionate voting weight.
